name: PromptKey
description:
Execute reusable AI prompts with global keyboard shortcuts.

Configure prompts and AI provider profiles (Gemini, Groq, OpenAI, or OpenAI-compatible endpoints). API keys stay on your machine in GSettings and are only sent to the provider you choose.

Clipboard: PromptKey can write the AI response to the clipboard when you click Copy, or when auto-copy is enabled in preferences. It never reads the clipboard and never sends clipboard data to any service.
